limitations: Pizza inputs are primitive generator metadata (topping counts, base, origin); component one-hot inputs are oracle detector-category identities. Neither is an image/pixel model.
Affine membership evidence cannot establish global ontology geometry or image recognition.
Component category is directly exposed as an oracle input; perfect component results are not visual-recognition evidence.
Pizza classes Food and Pizza are known-positive-only in train and validation, so negative discrimination is unsupported for those classes; the remaining 29 applicable pizza classes have both signs.
29 other classes are not applicable to pizza supervision; 30 classes are not applicable to component supervision. Per-class support records these statuses explicitly.
One shuffled-label control has limited statistical force. Its component result equals the class-frequency baseline; this remains a diagnostic, not a multi-seed claim.
Raw runs, generated dataset, full histories, images and logs are local/ignored. The tracked concise report and selected small best checkpoint do not make those raw artifacts remotely retrievable.
